manifest.description: A personal advisor that researches real stores and helps solve problems that may or may not end in a purchase. The Preferences tab is your own reference list — paste what matters into chat. It never buys anything — you do.
manifest.highlight_1: Diagnoses the problem before recommending anything — sometimes the answer is not a purchase at all
manifest.highlight_2: Paste the preferences that matter into chat — the advisor reads your messages, not the Preferences tab
manifest.highlight_3: Researches only the stores you name, and flags that prices come from public pages, not your signed-in account
manifest.highlight_4: It has no way to reach a cart or a checkout
manifest.highlight_5: Organize your saved preferences into groups in the Preferences tab
manifest.use_case_1: Research products from named public stores while keeping the decision, cart, account, and checkout under your control.
manifest.configuration_1: No store credentials are needed; save optional Preferences and Sites for your own reference, then paste the relevant constraints and store names into the advisor conversation.

historyTab.no_products_recommended_advice_was_the_s: No products recommended — advice was the solution
